scope: Retrospective diagnosis using only frozen TRAIN OOF predictions and existing rules. No alternative policy, threshold or weight was evaluated.
interpretation_limits: Seven development rooms previously examined; descriptive evidence, not a causal attribution percentage
Four fixed angle simulations, one building and weather year
Numerical ties use 1e-12; material-score thresholds reuse v3 predeclared near-optimal tolerances
Constrained_PV primary saved loss measures daylight deficit only; separate feasibility and conditional PV are required

statistical_fallacy_scan.Simpson_aggregation: Report room-level and macro results; kWh and mean relative percentages can rank strategies differently
statistical_fallacy_scan.Ecological_inference: No claim for all 476 rooms or real-world operation
statistical_fallacy_scan.Selection_Berkson: Only seven selected representative development rooms; population representativeness unverified
statistical_fallacy_scan.Collider_control: No new covariate controls or causal model used
statistical_fallacy_scan.Base_rate: Report optimal-angle frequency, ties and no-feasible base rates
statistical_fallacy_scan.Regression_to_mean: Frozen references retained; no causal before-after claim
statistical_fallacy_scan.Survivorship: All seven TRAIN rooms and all retained hours included; omitted hours remain out of scope
statistical_fallacy_scan.Look_elsewhere: All five saved methods and all existing policies reported, no significance tests
statistical_fallacy_scan.Forking_paths: Post-hoc descriptive diagnosis explicitly labeled; no alternate objectives evaluated
statistical_fallacy_scan.Correlation_causation: Mechanistic score decomposition distinguished from unverified simulation physics
statistical_fallacy_scan.Reverse_causality: No causal inference from predictive correlations
